title: Vikram and Betal: The Honest Friend

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about two friends.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about two close friends.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: One friend tried to hide his mistake.
scenes.image_prompt: friend looking worried hiding something cartoon

scenes.text: The friend admitted the truth when asked.
The friend supported him instead of getting angry.
Their friendship became stronger. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.

story: Two friends strengthened their bond through honesty and understanding. Vikram said honesty builds strong friendships.
